title: Maps out of sheaf sections are detected by finite-cover local lifts through epimorphisms
statement: Let (C,J), A and B have the finite covering basis hypotheses of [stage3-categorical-finite-cover-local-zero]. Let f:P→Q be an epimorphism of A-valued sheaves. For V satisfying B and b:Q(V)→T, suppose the following for every finite B-cover U of V: if a:E→Cech^0(U,P) and y:E→Q(V) have matching images in Cech^0(U,Q), then y≫b=0. Here Cech^0 is the finite product over one-fold repeated nerve terms, and matching images means Pi.map(f) composed with a equals the restriction of y. Then b=0.

source.place: Section 7.11, local description of sheaf epimorphisms; categorical proof by presheaf cokernel and coefficient refinements.

proof.text: Choose a finite B-cover refining the maximal sieve. Apply the hypothesis to restrictions of a global P-section to show f(V)≫b=0. Evaluation preserves cokernels, so descend b to a map beta from the presheaf cokernel R(V).
The counit isomorphisms of sheafification identify sheafification of f with the original sheaf epimorphism. Sheafification preserves cokernels, so the sheafification of R is zero.

For a generalized R(V)-section killed by a finite B-cover, lift it through Q(V) after a coefficient epimorphism. The finite product of the evaluated cokernel sequences is exact. Consequently refine once more and lift its restrictions simultaneously to a degree-zero P-cochain. Apply the assumed local test and cancel the two coefficient epimorphisms. Use the existing upstream ShortComplex.exact_iff_evaluation to detect the exactness of the finite diagram.
The locally-zero criterion applied to R makes beta zero, hence b zero.

theorem hom_eq_zero_of_finite_cover_lifts
    (B : C → Prop)
    (hcov : ∀ V, B V → ∀ R ∈ J V, ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → Over V),
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n), B (Presheaf.cechNerveObj U y).left) ∧
      (∀ a, R (U a).hom) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows (fun a ↦ (U a).left) (fun a ↦ (U a).hom) ∈ J V)
    {P Q : Sheaf J A} (f : P ⟶ Q) [Epi f] (V : C) (hV : B V)
    {T : A} (b : Q.obj.obj (op V) ⟶ T)
    (h : ∀ {n : ℕ} (U : Fin n → Over V),
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n), B (Presheaf.cechNerveObj U y).left) →
      Sieve.ofArrows (fun a ↦ (U a).left) (fun a ↦ (U a).hom) ∈ J V →
      ∀ {E : A}
        (a : E ⟶ ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj ((Over.forget V).op ⋙ P.obj)).X 0)
        (y : E ⟶ Q.obj.obj (op V)),
        a ≫ Limits.Pi.map (fun s : Fin 1 → Fin n ↦
          f.hom.app (op (Presheaf.cechNerveObj U s).left)) =
            y ≫ cechAugmentation U Over.mkIdTerminal ((Over.forget V).op ⋙ Q.obj) →
        y ≫ b = 0) : b = 0
